description: Turn hospital discharge paperwork into a clear recovery plan.
notes: Inlined Kit fallback implements the full contract and is active by design; app runs standalone with zero console errors (Playwright-verified).

notes.note: Discharge papers written for liability instead of humans is a real failure, and readmission penalties give hospitals dollar-denominated reasons to care. Weakest assumption: hospital sales cycles and IT departments, which will take two years to kill your enthusiasm. The consumer freemium side is a distraction from the real buyer.
Medicine checkboxes toggle; copy-plan + recovery-plan-built work; zero errors.

notes.change: Med schedule now groups doses by inferred time-of-day (Morning/Evening/As needed) and taken-checks reset daily (dated localStorage key); fixed explainer modal action styling.
